name: Gases
title: Jewish Leader During the Return
summary: Gases (also known as Gazzam or possibly a variant of a name from the return period) is a person mentioned in connection with Israel's return from the Babylonian exile. He is listed among the descendants of the temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem. His family contributed to rebuilding the service and worship of the temple.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Temple Servants
keyEvents.description: Gases' descendants are mentioned among the Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Nehemiah's List
keyEvents.description: Gases' family is also listed in Nehemiah's register of those who returned from exile, confirming the family's role among the temple servants.

keyEvents.title: Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: As part of the great return under Zerubbabel's leadership, Gases' descendants returned to restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Temple
keyEvents.description: The temple servants, including Gases' family, played an important role in supporting the priests and Levites during the rebuilding of the second temple.
